So model family: models identified by meter size: 50mm, 65mm, 80mm, 100mm, 150mm, 200mm.

- Accuracy class: 2

- Q3/Q1: 500
- Environmental class: T50 (0.1C to 50C) — hmm, "T50 (0.1C to 50C)" probably temperature class T50, range 0.1°C to 50°C? Actually for water meters, temperature classes: T30, T50. T50 means 0.1°C to 50°C. So environmental_class_temperature: T50, with range 0.1-50 °C.
- Environmental class: C (-25° to 55°C) — climatic environmental class C, -25 to 55 °C.
- Electromagnetic environment: E1

- Minimum straight length outlet: D0
- Flow conditioner: None
- Mounting orientation: any position
- Checking facilities: Measurement transducer, Calculator & Indicator; type P

2. 40 and 50 mm Plastic Body — plastic body, with table:
